name: End of the fifth wave: a reversal
idea: A signal when the fifth wave of an impulse may be complete and the market turns, by the trigger style you pick; mostly for traders who trade against the finished move.

params.label: Wave timeframe
params.help: The chart where the waves are counted (the minor trend). Not finer than your signal timeframe.

params.label: Higher timeframe
params.help: The chart of the main trend. Not finer than the wave timeframe.

params.label: Wave size
params.help: Which swings count as waves: 1 is the smallest, 3 the largest. Larger waves need more history.

params.label: Smaller swing size
params.help: The smaller swings inside a wave: they mark the turn of the smaller structure and the last smaller swing. Smaller than the wave size.

params.label: Higher trend
params.help: With the higher trend: the move the idea expects must point the same way as the swing trend on the higher timeframe.

params.label: Higher trend swing size
params.help: Which swings on the higher timeframe decide its trend: 0 is the smallest, 3 the largest.

params.label: Trigger style
params.help: What turns the setup into a signal: the smaller structure turning on your chart, the close beyond the line through the ends of waves two and four, or the retest of that broken line.
choice_labels: The smaller structure turns on your chart
A close beyond the line through the ends of waves two and four
The retest of the broken line

params.label: Count clarity
params.help: An unclear count never gives a signal. Optionally also skip a count whose alternate reading points the other way.
choice_labels: Any count that is not unclear
Not when the alternate count points the other way

params.label: Watch after the count
params.help: How many bars of your chart the idea is watched after the count last showed the fifth wave (the count moves on once the end of that wave is confirmed).

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the level a close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: Retest window
params.help: For the retest style: the bars after the break within which the retest must come.

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The extreme of the fifth wave, or the last smaller swing.
choice_labels: The extreme of the fifth wave

params.label: Exit signal
params.help: Optional: when the idea has ended. It is not acted on yet; your own exit settings always apply.
choice_labels: The wave structure turns against the idea

constraints.message: The wave timeframe must not be finer than your signal timeframe.
The higher timeframe must not be finer than the wave timeframe.
The smaller swings must be smaller than the waves.

setup.long: Count($hold_bars, (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND (WaveType($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMPULSE" OR WaveType($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "DIAGONAL") AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "1")@{wave_tf} < WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} < WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} AND (WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "UNCLEAR" AND ($min_clarity == "any" OR WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "ALT_DISAGREES")))) > 0
setup.short: Count($hold_bars, (WaveState($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMP_5" AND (WaveType($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "IMPULSE" OR WaveType($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} == "DIAGONAL") AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "1")@{wave_tf} > WaveOrigin($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} AND WaveEnd($wave_degree, "current")@{wave_tf} > WaveEnd($wave_degree, "3")@{wave_tf} AND (WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "UNCLEAR" AND ($min_clarity == "any" OR WaveClarity($wave_degree)@{wave_tf} != "ALT_DISAGREES")))) > 0
